inventory.newTask: Structured CSV comparison by an explicitly selected unique key, rather than the existing line-based text diff or JSON conversion.

evidence.google: Public Google search returned a CAPTCHA. Not bypassed; DuckDuckGo observations are not Google rankings.

candidateComparison.reason: Clear task phrases, existing CSV/JSON audience and reusable parser. A useful repeat-export review workflow without hosting uploaded files. Competitive, not an uncovered market.
Relevant adjacent conversion, but CSVJSON already offers CSV/TSV/Markdown inputs and several output types. Broader generic conversion adds less distinct workflow value here.
Fits existing leading-zero guides but several observed tools already offer typed XLSX and identifier preservation. Avoid another generic converter this turn.
RealFaviconGenerator already covers SVG, mobile previews, markup and framework installation. Partial overlap with existing image conversion; demands a wider platform correctness matrix.
Useful but observed results include WebAIM, Adobe, Coolors and W3Schools with mature free workflows. No measured easier-ranking evidence.
Autocomplete wording exists, but overlaps existing robots generator and has crawler-semantics complexity. SERP unavailable in this run; Ryte URL now says its old free tool is unavailable.

competitorReview.method: Documentation and native browser synthetic test
competitorReview.observation: A=id,price + 001,10 + 002,20; B=same rows reversed. Output was 2 added, 2 removed, 1 unchanged (header). Correct for positional text diff but noisy for export reconciliation.
Explicitly line/field-position comparison and asks for sorted files; unbounded size with browser-memory caveat. Historic comments are not proof of current bugs.
Paste/files, parse controls, table/text view, XLSX/CSV/HTML exports and optional sharing. These are already established features, not unique opportunities.

competitorReview.method: Documentation and native browser synthetic setup test
competitorReview.observation: Supports single/composite/full-row comparison and mappings. With duplicate id rows and unique prices, default setup selected price as the key and showed 2/3 normalization rules active. No incorrect final-result claim made; test did not run a final comparison. Our design requires deliberate key selection and exact comparison defaults.
Key-based matching, filtering and downloadable reports already advertised; no numeric file limit stated in the reviewed FAQ.
Already supports composite keys, mappings, join modes, normalization, several encodings and report formats. Local processing alone is not a differentiator.

targeting.name: CSV Diff Checker
targeting.title: CSV Diff Checker: Compare Two CSV Files by Key
targeting.description: Compare two CSV files by ID or composite key. Find added, removed and changed rows, inspect duplicate keys, and export reports locally with no uploads.
secondary: compare two csv files for differences
targeting.urlRationale: Short, descriptive, hyphenated task URL without a year or extra exact-match landing pages.
targeting.intent: Interactive export comparison for developers, analysts and store operators; not a general spreadsheet editor or an automatic data merger.

implementationContract.input: Local CSV/TSV files or pasted text. Explicit per-input delimiter and encoding; UTF-8 default. Header required, duplicate headers and ragged/invalid CSV rejected. Preserve strings and leading zeros.
implementationContract.matching: User-selected one or more shared key columns; row/column reordering ignored. Duplicate or blank keys fail with record numbers rather than picking a row. Compare selected shared columns; excluded and unshared columns explicitly disclosed.
implementationContract.results: Exact counts, changes-only filters, search, bounded paginated preview, full before/after cell evidence and report exports. Input/settings changes invalidate prior results. No automatic source-file editing.
implementationContract.limits: Bounded worker, input/row/column/cell/output budgets, cancel and timeout; no silent truncation or unbounded file claims.
implementationContract.privacy: Reuse the private-tool document boundary to exclude site analytics/ads/chat from this route; restrictive same-origin CSP; no input upload, URL import, automatic content persistence or new API endpoint.
implementationContract.seo: Static server-rendered content, self canonical, unique H1/title/description, custom static social image, WebApplication and BreadcrumbList. Visible FAQs without promising Google FAQ rich results.
implementationContract.discovery: Tools catalogue/search, reciprocal related tools, XML and HTML sitemap, llms.txt and chat description, contextual links in relevant existing tool help. No live database edits or unsolicited outreach.

primarySources.use: CSV records, quoted multiline fields, escaped quotes and spaces as data; informational RFC rather than a universal CSV implementation guarantee.
Installed Papa Parse 5.7.0; keep dynamicTyping false, header false for explicit validation, parse quoted fields, report errors and serialize safely.
Formula initiators including full-width variants, quoting, mitigation trade-offs and no universal safe CSV sanitizer. Preserve exact machine-readable data separately from spreadsheet-oriented export.
Functional people-first main content and original testing rather than keyword stuffing, invented authority or arbitrary word counts.
Current official changelog: Google FAQ rich results removed starting May 7, 2026; old FAQ documentation redirects here. Do not promise FAQ rich-result visibility.

measurementPlan.beforeRelease: Verify functionality, downloads, keyboard/mobile layout, indexable HTML, canonical, social image and discovery links. These are engineering results, not search traffic.
measurementPlan.afterRelease: In owner-authenticated Search Console, filter exact new page; record indexed/canonical status and 7/28/56-day impressions, clicks, CTR and observed queries. Compare to first available baseline; do not manufacture numbers.
measurementPlan.privacy: Do not put CSV data, filenames, keys, result values or reports in analytics. No analytics collection added to the private workspace. User-observed pilot success can be recorded without uploading files.
measurementPlan.successCriterion: Users can correctly identify real changes and export a reviewable report; search growth evaluated only when real data exists.
measurementPlan.limitations: A new tool cannot fix all site authority, indexing or acquisition issues. No ranking, revenue, perfect security or traffic guarantee.

core.scope: Synthetic parser, encoding, key matching, limits, exact reports and worker protocol tests; no user data.

uiAndSeo.scope: Actual server-rendered page and client, canonical, schema, native FAQ disclosures, discovery, isolated shell, root service-worker exclusions and actual 1200x630 PNG.

browser.checks: Native Edge file inputs, actual workers and CSV/JSON downloads; composite/duplicate keys, stale result invalidation, controlled failure/cancellation tests, keyboard, 16 empty/populated axe scans, no data-bearing network or persistence, public/private document changes, no-JavaScript state. Real device and Safari validation not performed.

build.mode: production Next build in a credential-free disposable copy; default bundler after initial Webpack validation
build.fontMode: Existing cached fonts in preview; production font configuration unchanged.

previewAcceptance.privateToolNavigation: CSV Diff to ImageFixer and back replaces the document, so each private tool receives its own CSP. Verified in the final build.
previewAcceptance.limits: Single unthrottled desktop synthetic run; timings include UI overhead. Not a physical mobile test, peak memory measurement or universal speed promise.

lighthouse.environment: Loopback production preview in Edge, lab navigation; no field data or authenticated analytics.
lighthouse.limits: Scores vary with the host and simulated throttling. Mobile report warns that the test CPU is slower than Lighthouse expects. Below-fold informational sections defer offscreen rendering; score differences are not a controlled causal benchmark. Mobile performance still needs improvement. SEO score is technical audit coverage, NOT rank, traffic or indexing proof.

validation.privacyAndCost: No new dependency, upload API, AI/provider call or database processing. Static page/social image plus client worker; ordinary page/CDN transfer still costs hosting resources. No zero-cost or unlimited-usage guarantee.

releaseBlockers.action: Review and patch existing dependency advisories with application regression tests before public release; no forced audit fix or unreviewed downgrade was applied. Obtain explicit push approval.
